item.title: Norwegian crown princess apologizes to royals and all ‘disappointed’ by her Epstein contacts
item.description: "It is important for me to apologize to all of you whom I have disappointed," she said. "Some of the content of the messages between Epstein and me does not represent the person I want to be. I also apologize for the situation I have put the Royal Family in, especially the King and Queen."

item.title: Can apes play pretend? Scientists use an imaginary tea party to find out
item.description: "What's really exciting about this work is that it suggests that the roots of this capacity for imagination are not unique to our species," said study co-author Christopher Krupenye with Johns Hopkins University.

item.title: Robert Redford’s character in 1969 film ‘Downhill Racer’ still resonates with American ski racers
item.description: "The movie encapsulates the pursuit of excellence that we're trying to accomplish and it exudes such an aura around what we do," explained U.S. racer River Radamus, who's competing in his second Olympics at the Milan Cortina Games. "I love that movie. That's part of why I wanted to do what I do today."

item.title: They will have been to all 60 Super Bowls. This year is possibly their last
item.description: "This will definitely be the final one," said Crisman, who made the trip with his daughter, Susan Metevier. "We made it to 60."

item.title: Ravioli filled with red beets is the colorful pasta dish of Olympic host Cortina
item.description: "It's a typical local dish. My favorite casunziei are the ones cooked by my grandmother — the spinach ones," Stefania Constantini, a defending Olympic curling champion in mixed doubles and a Cortina native, told The Associated Press.
